description: Elections Commission - H. A. Y. C. Hathurusinghe, M. N. Deepthi and S. K. Edirisinghe of the Horana Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of the Horana Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters such as candidate registrations, vacating of offices, and electoral commission decisions.
